name: San Francisco
blurb: Every street is uphill, including the downhill ones. The fog has a residential permit.

signs.text: PARK CUT. Flatter. Muddier. Unfunded.
STAIR ALLEY: KEEP RIGHT. No vehicles. Especially yours.
JONES STREET: KEEP RIGHT. 29% grade. Not a typo.
YIELD TO CABLE CARS. They cannot yield to you.
STEEP GRADE: 4 BLOCKS. Then a steeper one.
STREET CLEANING TUESDAY 6 AM. Ticketing began Monday.
2 HR PARKING. 0 SPACES. 7 am to 6 pm.
BRIDGE TOLL $9. View not included.
TOLL BY PLATE. SMILE.
signs.note: NEW, playtest 4, P1 (the wave C check: the Golden Gate toll gantry's board was a blank panel): the words on the toll gantry's board, white on highway green. A text surface, not a board: the game paints it on the model's `toll_gantry_sign` panel (docs/content-packs.md, Text surfaces), and cutting it in the game leaves the board blank. An invented line, vetoable like any sign.

signs.text: ROBOTAXI ZONE. Do not place cones on hoods.
BUS STOP: SHUTTLES ONLY. Buses by appointment.
VISIBILITY 200 FT. Summer has begun.
CURB YOUR WHEELS. Your car wants to leave.
NO PARKING, NO STOPPING. No reason given.
CABLE CAR TRACKS. Grip is for the car, not you.
THIS INTERSECTION IS IN BETA. Report crashes to the cable car.
NO TURNS. Pivots by appointment.
RIGHT LANE CLOSED. Product launch in progress.
WALK SIGNAL DEPRECATED. Walking is a legacy feature.
CABLE CAR CROSSING. It has seniority.
LOADING ZONE: SERVERS ONLY. Humans unload elsewhere.
CAMPUS AHEAD. Badge in to continue.
PLAZA ENTRANCE: DELIVERIES ONLY. Founders arrive by ramp.
SEAWALL BUILT 1913. Upgrade under review since 1914.
NO SWIMMING. No fishing. No pitching.
EVEN PIERS ONLY. Odd piers past the clock.
FOGHORN TESTED DAILY. Results pending.
FERRY SCHEDULE: ASPIRATIONAL. Next boat when it feels ready.
ODD PIERS AHEAD. Nobody has asked why.
TIDE: HIGH. Rent: higher.
SEA LIONS ON PIER. The pier has been informed.
DON'T FEED THE SEA LIONS. They have a meal plan.
LANTERNS OVERHEAD. Robotaxi sensors, look up.
ROBOTAXIS: NARROW STREET. Narrower than your training data.
STEEP GRADE AHEAD. Your brakes have been notified.
NO SCOOTER PARKING. Yes, the rental one too.
CABLE BELL ZONE. The bell is not a suggestion.
NO SHUTTLE TURNS. The street was here first.
NO LAPTOPS ON THE PATIO. The laptops have appealed.
NO PITCHING AT THE COUNTER. Order first. Disrupt later.
PUBLIC WI-FI ENDS. Pitch decks, save locally.
LOADING ZONE: FOUNDERS. Pitching from 6 am.
SHARP RIGHT. Brake now. Pivot later.
SCENIC OVERLOOK. View may contain fog.
RING LIGHT PARKING ONLY. 15 minutes. Golden hour excepted.
MURAL ALLEY. No drones. The walls have seen enough content.
SPONSORED WALL. Sponsorship ended this morning.
SCAFFOLD AHEAD. Painters have right of way. And rollers.
WET PAINT. Do not stay tuned.

billboards.text: SLEEP AS A SERVICE. First 8 hours free.
WE REINVENTED THE BUS. $40M raised. It's a bus.
NOW HIRING: PROMPT WHISPERER. Senior role. 10 years' experience required.
AI FOR YOUR AI. Delegatron writes the prompts for your other AI.
TOAST, THOUGHT THROUGH. Toastwise reasons it step by step.
ROBOTAXI ARRIVING: 4 MIN. Since 9 am. Emptyseat.
RENT A GPU HOUR. Now just the price of a studio.
YOUR FRIDGE HAS OPINIONS. Coldcase, now with a chatbot. Series B.
AGI BY TUESDAY. Which Tuesday is confidential.
NOW RAISING SERIES Z. We ran out of letters, not money.
WE ARE INEVITABLE. That's the whole ad.
FERRY, NOW ON BLOCKCHAIN. Ferrychain. It still takes 30 minutes.
ARFSCRIBE TRANSLATES SEA LIONS. AI-powered. So far it's all 'fish'.
FOGCASTR: AI FOG FORECASTS. Today: fog. Tomorrow: fog. Series A.
OPEN MIC FOR CHATBOTS. Humans read alternate Thursdays.
YOUR ESPRESSO, BENCHMARKED. Puckbench. In private beta.

landingLines.text: TEN OUT OF TEN, SAYS A SEA LION
THE FOG GIVES IT A SEVEN
A CABLE CAR RANG ONCE. HIGH PRAISE.
A ROBOTAXI LOGGED IT AS AN INCIDENT

smashables.note: Run W-T. City parking meters along the kerb.
Run W-T. An invented startup's pop-up desk parked on the pavement. Startups only, never Chinatown's shops (pitch deck).
Run W-T. Pavement cafe tables. Never Chinatown's shops (pitch deck).
Run W-U. An invented startup's pop-up desk on the waterfront's promenade and sidewalks. On the waterfront only pop-ups and cafe tables smash (the brief).
Run W-U. Cafe tables out on the waterfront's promenade and sidewalks.

Run W-U. North Beach's pavement cafe tables (the `cafes` tag). Nothing smashes in Chinatown: no smashable lists its `lanterns` or `side-street` tags (the brief; the pitch deck cut the grocery crates).
Run W-U. A pop-up renting ring lights to film in front of the murals: the streaming outfit's crowd, never the neighbourhood's own shops.

meta.notes: Region pack region-sf (playtest 1c, 2026-09-30). The palette keys follow the renderer's material names (sky, water, road, shoulder, land, rail, markingCenter) plus fog and the row-house and cable-car colours, which paint the row-house and cable-car models (W-O, 2026-10-01); `fogBank` lays fog banks offshore. Chapter 3 assumes the Pacific Northwest is chapter 2 ("Pnw and sf first"); the order is the maintainer's call. The mix names three region vehicles (placeholder shapes from the base presets) beside base traffic; a kind listed nowhere never spawns. Every sign and billboard is placed by a billboard slot on the sf-hills or sf-downtown roads. Run W-R (interview, 2026-10-02: "SF first = downtown towers"; playtest 2: the cable cars drove "including in forests"): the downtown network joins with its own signs and billboards, and the cable car leaves the traffic mix, so cable cars run only on downtown's steep cable-car cross streets (render/downtown.ts), never on a race road. Run W-U (the pitch deck's #8, "Later"): the waterfront network joins with its own `wf-` signs and billboards, and its own smashables (startup pop-ups and cafe tables only). Run W-U (pitch deck #8): the Chinatown and North Beach network joins with its own signs (`cn-`, `nb-`) and billboards; its cafe tables smash in North Beach only (the `cafes` tag), and nothing smashes in Chinatown. Run W-U (the pitch deck after playtest 2, #8: "the Mission's mural alleys"): the mural network joins with its own signs (`mi-` ids, on its shopfront sidewalks); parking meters and cafe tables also stand on its shopfront sidewalks, beside a ring-light pop-up of its own.
